question: Should ordinary default-agent runs stop receiving HEARTBEAT.md by default when heartbeat guidance is enabled, reserving that file for actual heartbeat runs?
rationale: Current documentation and source deliberately permit HEARTBEAT.md in normal runs, so the token optimization changes established context semantics and cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Make heartbeat loading run-kind aware
options.body: Exclude HEARTBEAT.md before reads and caching on ordinary runs while retaining it for actual heartbeat runs; this is the narrowest solution and avoids another config key.

options.title: Offer an explicit bootstrap policy
options.body: Preserve current defaults and let users opt into selective loading through a maintainer-approved broader bootstrap policy, accepting additional configuration and migration surface.

options.title: Keep the current contract
options.body: Retain normal-run heartbeat guidance and close the optimization request because cross-turn visibility is considered more valuable than the token savings.

recommendation.title: Make heartbeat loading run-kind aware
recommendation.body: Exclude HEARTBEAT.md before reads and caching on ordinary runs while retaining it for actual heartbeat runs; this is the narrowest solution and avoids another config key.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and prior issue review most directly connect this person to the current heartbeat prompt and bootstrap-context contract.
